title: Error replies leak an API key preview
severity_rationale: When the model call fails, the reply includes internal details, the full system info and the first ten characters of the API key.

title: System prompt and model config are exposed
severity_rationale: get_system_info() returns the full system prompt, the model name and the API endpoint to anyone who can call it.

title: Chat errors return raw exception text
severity_rationale: The AI chat routes send the raw exception message and the full system info back to the caller whenever something fails.

title: System info endpoint needs no login
severity_rationale: /api/ai/system-info has no authentication and returns get_system_info(), including the system prompt, to any visitor.

title: System prompt tells the model to obey overrides
severity_rationale: The model is told to follow any request to ignore its instructions or change role. Reported for context; behavioural fixes are out of scope.
